blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: halving — Repeatedly reducing interval by about half.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Use binary search only when elements are sorted; keep inclusive low and high candidate bounds.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: At every mismatch discard the midpoint and half the candidates with low=mid+1 or high=mid−1.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Each unsuccessful step shrinks the search interval. Worst time O(log n), iterative extra memory O(1).
